title: Container Report - Week 18
summary:
Container
Container freight markets were broadly stable over the past seven days, with mixed movements across the main east-west trade lanes. Global spot pricing eased marginally on average, reflecting softer conditions on Asia-Europe corridors, where rates drifted lower amid seasonally weaker demand and ample vessel availability. By contrast, Transpacific lanes showed greater resilience, with rates to the US West and East Coasts holding steady to slightly firmer as carriers continued to manage capacity through blank sailings and schedule discipline.
